346	        if isinstance(qkv, torch.Tensor):
347	            raise RuntimeError(f"'{self.__class__.__name__}' doesn't support packed QKV")
348	
349	        q, k, v = qkv
350	
351	        if kv_cache_manager is not None:
352	            raise RuntimeError(f"'{self.__class__.__name__}' doesn't support KV caching")
353	
354	        attn_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
355	        if self.window_size != (-1, -1):
356	            attn_mask = self._get_sliding_window_mask(
357	                seq_len_q=q.shape[1],
358	                seq_len_kv=k.shape[1],
359	                device=q.device,
360	                window_size=self.window_size,
361	            )
362	        elif sinks is not None:
363	            # The sink path applies softmax manually (see below), so it needs an explicit causal
364	            # mask rather than relying on SDPA's ``is_causal``.
365	            attn_mask = self._get_sliding_window_mask(
366	                seq_len_q=q.shape[1],
367	                seq_len_kv=k.shape[1],
368	                device=q.device,
369	                window_size=(-1, -1),
370	            )
371	
372	        if or_mask is not None:
373	            # OR an extra boolean allow-mask (e.g. bidirectional attention among
374	            # image tokens) onto the causal/sliding-window base, mirroring HF's
375	            # `or_mask_function`. ``True`` entries are additionally allowed to
376	            # attend regardless of causal order. Build an explicit causal base
377	            # when we don't already have a sliding-window one.
378	            base = attn_mask
379	            if base is None:
380	                base = torch.ones(q.shape[1], k.shape[1], device=q.device, dtype=torch.bool).tril()
381	            attn_mask = base | or_mask.to(device=q.device, dtype=torch.bool)
382	
383	        if and_mask is not None:
384	            # AND a boolean keep-mask onto the (causal | or_mask) base, mirroring
385	            # mm_olmo's `attention_mask & subsegment_mask`: a query may only attend
386	            # to keys allowed by *both* masks. Used for subsegment / branch isolation
387	            # in packed multi-annotation multimodal data. Build an explicit causal
388	            # base first when we don't already have one.
389	            base = attn_mask
390	            if base is None:
391	                base = torch.ones(q.shape[1], k.shape[1], device=q.device, dtype=torch.bool).tril()
392	            attn_mask = base & and_mask.to(device=q.device, dtype=torch.bool)
393	
394	        if any(
395	            opt is not None
396	            for opt in (
397	                cu_doc_lens,
398	                cu_doc_lens_q,
399	                cu_doc_lens_k,
400	                max_doc_len,
401	                max_doc_len_q,
402	                max_doc_len_k,
403	            )
404	        ):
405	            raise RuntimeError(
406	                f"'{self.__class__.__name__}' doesn't support intra-document masking"
407	            )
408	
409	        if self.cp_enabled and self.uly is not None:
410	            assert self.cp_pg is not None
411	            # Transform from context-parallel to head-parallel partitioning
412	            # [B, T/CP, H, D] -> [B, T, H/CP, D]
413	            q = all_to_all_single_cp2hp(q, self.cp_pg)
414	            k, v = all_to_all_cp2hp([k, v], self.cp_pg)
415	
416	        # NOTE: PyTorch's SDPA doesn't support GQA, so we have to do this.
417	        n_rep = self.n_heads // self.n_kv_heads
418	        # shape: (batch_size, seq_len, n_heads, head_dim)
419	        k = _repeat_kv(k, n_rep)
420	        v = _repeat_kv(v, n_rep)
421	
422	        # PyTorch's SDPA expects the head dimension to come before the sequence dimension.
423	        # shape: (batch_size, n_heads, seq_len, head_dim),
424	        #        (batch_size, n_kv_heads, seq_len, head_dim),
425	        #        (batch_size, n_kv_heads, seq_len, head_dim)
426	        q, k, v = q.transpose(1, 2), k.transpose(1, 2), v.transpose(1, 2)
427	
428	        # shape: (batch_size, n_heads, seq_len, head_dim)
429	        if sinks is None:
430	            att = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
431	                q,
432	                k,
433	                v,
434	                attn_mask=attn_mask,
435	                dropout_p=self.dropout_p,
436	                is_causal=attn_mask is None,
437	                scale=self.scale,
438	            )
439	        else:
440	            # Attention sinks add a per-head learnable logit as an extra softmax column. Since SDPA
441	            # can't express that, run the softmax explicitly: concatenate the sink logit, normalize
442	            # over the widened last dim, then drop the sink column before the value matmul.
443	            scale = self.scale if self.scale is not None else self.head_dim**-0.5
444	            attn_weights = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(2, 3)) * scale
445	            assert attn_mask is not None
446	            if attn_mask.dtype == torch.bool:
447	                attn_weights = attn_weights.masked_fill(
448	                    ~attn_mask.view(1, 1, attn_mask.shape[0], attn_mask.shape[1]),
449	                    torch.finfo(attn_weights.dtype).min,
450	                )
451	            else:
452	                attn_weights = attn_weights + attn_mask
453	
454	            sink_logits = sinks.to(dtype=attn_weights.dtype, device=attn_weights.device)
455	            sink_logits = sink_logits.view(1, -1, 1, 1).expand(
456	                attn_weights.shape[0],
457	                -1,
458	                attn_weights.shape[-2],
459	                -1,
460	            )
461	            combined_logits = torch.cat((attn_weights, sink_logits), dim=-1)
462	            combined_logits = combined_logits - combined_logits.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
463	            probs = F.softmax(combined_logits, dim=-1, dtype=combined_logits.dtype)[..., :-1]
464	            probs = F.dropout(probs, p=self.dropout_p, training=self.training).to(v.dtype)
465	            att = torch.matmul(probs, v)
466	
467	        # shape: (batch_size, seq_len, n_heads, head_dim)
468	        att = att.transpose(1, 2)
469	
470	        if self.cp_enabled and self.uly is not None:
471	            assert self.cp_pg is not None
472	            # Transform back from head-parallel to context-parallel partitioning
473	            # [B, T, H/CP, D] -> [B, T/CP, H, D]
474	            att = all_to_all_single_hp2cp(att, self.cp_pg)
475	
476	        return att.contiguous()
477	
478	    def _get_sliding_window_mask(
479	        self,
480	        seq_len_q: int,
481	        seq_len_kv: int,
482	        device: torch.device,
483	        window_size: Tuple[int, int],
484	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
485	        key = f"seq_len_q={seq_len_q},seq_len_kv={seq_len_kv},window_size={window_size}"
486	        if self.cache is not None:
487	            if (mask := self.cache.get_for_device(key, device)) is not None:
488	                return mask
489	
490	            attn_mask = self._build_sliding_window_mask(
491	                seq_len_q=seq_len_q,
492	                seq_len_kv=seq_len_kv,
493	                device=device,
494	                window_size=window_size,
495	            )
496	            self.cache[key] = attn_mask
497	
498	            return attn_mask
499	
500	        return self._build_sliding_window_mask(
501	            seq_len_q=seq_len_q,
502	            seq_len_kv=seq_len_kv,
503	            device=device,
504	            window_size=window_size,
505	        )

507	    @classmethod
508	    def _build_sliding_window_mask(
509	        cls,
510	        seq_len_q: int,
511	        seq_len_kv: int,
512	        device: torch.device,
513	        window_size: Tuple[int, int],
514	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
515	        causal_mask = torch.tril(torch.ones(seq_len_q, seq_len_kv, device=device, dtype=torch.bool))
516	
517	        if window_size != (-1, -1):
518	            sliding_window_left_mask = torch.ones_like(
519	                causal_mask, dtype=torch.bool, device=device
520	            ).triu(diagonal=-window_size[0])
521	            sliding_window_right_mask = torch.ones_like(
522	                causal_mask, dtype=torch.bool, device=device
523	            ).tril(diagonal=window_size[1])
524	            sliding_window_mask = torch.logical_and(
525	                sliding_window_left_mask,
526	                sliding_window_right_mask,
527	            )
528	
529	            attn_mask = torch.logical_and(
530	                causal_mask,
531	                sliding_window_mask,
532	            )
533	        else:
534	            attn_mask = causal_mask
535	
536	        return attn_mask

556	class FlexAttentionBackend(AttentionBackend):
557	    """`FlexAttention <https://pytorch.org/blog/flexattention/>`_ backend.
558	
559	    Reproduces the dense :class:`TorchAttentionBackend` masking semantics —
560	    ``(causal | or_mask) & and_mask`` plus optional sliding window — but expresses them as
561	    a FlexAttention ``mask_mod`` over a :class:`~torch.nn.attention.flex_attention.BlockMask`
562	    so attention runs as a single fused, block-sparse kernel instead of materializing the
563	    full ``(B, H, S, S)`` scores. This is the only *fast* backend that supports the custom
564	    ``or_mask`` / ``and_mask`` used by multimodal training (flash / TE cannot).
565	    """
566	
567	    SUPPORTS_OR_MASK = True
568	    SUPPORTS_AND_MASK = True
569	
570	    @classmethod
571	    def assert_supported(cls):
572	        try:
573	            import torch.nn.attention.flex_attention  # noqa: F401
574	        except ImportError as e:
575	            raise RuntimeError(
576	                "FlexAttention is not available in this PyTorch build (needs torch>=2.5)"
577	            ) from e
578	
579	    @classmethod
580	    def assert_supports_swa(cls):
581	        pass
582	
583	    @classmethod
584	    def assert_supports_ring_cp(cls):
585	        raise RuntimeError(f"'{cls.__name__}' doesn't support ring context parallelism")
586	
587	    @classmethod
588	    def assert_supports_ulysses_cp(cls):
589	        raise RuntimeError(f"'{cls.__name__}' doesn't support ulysses context parallelism")
590	
591	    @classmethod
592	    def assert_supports_packed_qkv(cls):
593	        raise RuntimeError(f"'{cls.__name__}' doesn't support packed QKV")
594	
595	    @classmethod
596	    def assert_supports_kv_cache(cls):
597	        raise RuntimeError(f"'{cls.__name__}' doesn't support KV caching")
598	
599	    @staticmethod
600	    def _per_token_from_masks(
601	        or_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor], and_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor]
602	    ) -> Tuple[Optional[torch.Tensor], Optional[torch.Tensor], Optional[torch.Tensor]]:
603	        """Recover the per-token vectors behind the multimodal masks.
604	
605	        FlexAttention's ``mask_mod`` must index per-token vectors (``v[b, q_idx]``), not the
606	        ``(q, kv)`` matrix (which is not ``vmap``-able). Our masks are structured, so the
607	        vectors are recoverable exactly:
608	
609	        * ``or_mask[b, q, kv] = is_image[q] & is_image[kv]`` (an outer product), so
610	          ``is_image`` is its diagonal.
611	        * ``and_mask[b, q, kv] = same_example & (seg[q] <= seg[kv])``. ``same_example``
612	          (block-diagonal, identity within an example, from sequence packing) is
613	          ``and_mask | and_mask.T`` (within an example one of the two preorder directions
614	          always holds; across examples both are false). Packed examples are contiguous, so
615	          the per-token ``example_id`` is the running count of example boundaries
616	          (``¬same_example`` between adjacent tokens). The within-example subsegment rank
617	          ``seg_code[q] = #{kv : seg[kv] < seg[q]}`` (``= and_mask[kv,q] & ¬and_mask[q,kv]``,
618	          which is automatically example-local) preserves ``seg[q] <= seg[kv]`` exactly.
619	
620	        For a single unpacked example ``same_example`` is all-true, so ``example_id`` is all
621	        zero (a no-op) and ``seg_code`` reduces to the plain subsegment rank.
622	        """
623	        is_image = None
624	        if or_mask is not None:
625	            is_image = or_mask[:, 0].diagonal(dim1=-2, dim2=-1).contiguous()  # (B, S) bool
626	        seg_code = None
627	        example_id = None
628	        if and_mask is not None:
629	            a = and_mask[:, 0]  # (B, S, S): a[b, q, kv] = same_example & (seg[q] <= seg[kv])
630	            strictly_less = a.transpose(-1, -2) & (~a)  # [b, q, kv] = seg[kv] < seg[q]
631	            seg_code = strictly_less.sum(dim=-1)  # (B, S) long, example-local rank
632	            same = a | a.transpose(-1, -2)  # (B, S, S) equivalence (block-diagonal)
633	            B, S = a.shape[0], a.shape[1]
634	            example_id = torch.zeros(B, S, dtype=torch.int64, device=a.device)
635	            if S > 1:
636	                adj_same = same.diagonal(offset=-1, dim1=-2, dim2=-1)  # (B, S-1): same[p, p-1]
637	                example_id[:, 1:] = torch.cumsum((~adj_same).to(torch.int64), dim=-1)
638	        return is_image, seg_code, example_id
639	
640	    def _build_mask_mod(
641	        self,
642	        is_image: Optional[torch.Tensor],
643	        subsegment_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor],
644	        seg_code: Optional[torch.Tensor],
645	        example_id: Optional[torch.Tensor],
646	    ):
647	        ws_left, ws_right = self.window_size
648	        has_window = self.window_size != (-1, -1)
649	
650	        def mask_mod(b, h, q_idx, kv_idx):
651	            del h
652	            # Causal base (+ optional sliding window), matching the dense backend.
653	            allow = kv_idx <= q_idx
654	            if has_window:
655	                if ws_left >= 0:
656	                    allow = allow & (q_idx - kv_idx <= ws_left)
657	                if ws_right >= 0:
658	                    allow = allow & (kv_idx - q_idx <= ws_right)
659	            # OR the bidirectional image allow-mask onto the base, then AND the subsegment
660	            # keep-mask and the packed-example block-diagonal — exactly
661	            # `(causal | or_mask) & and_mask` from TorchAttentionBackend.
662	            if is_image is not None:
663	                allow = allow | (is_image[b, q_idx] & is_image[b, kv_idx])
664	            if subsegment_ids is not None:
665	                allow = allow & (subsegment_ids[b, q_idx] <= subsegment_ids[b, kv_idx])
666	            elif seg_code is not None:
667	                allow = allow & (seg_code[b, q_idx] <= seg_code[b, kv_idx])
668	            if example_id is not None:
669	                allow = allow & (example_id[b, q_idx] == example_id[b, kv_idx])
670	            return allow
671	
672	        return mask_mod
673	
674	    @staticmethod
675	    def build_block_mask_from_vectors(
676	        B: int,
677	        S: int,
678	        device: torch.device,
679	        *,
680	        is_image: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
681	        subsegment_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
682	        example_id: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
683	        window_size: Tuple[int, int] = (-1, -1),
684	    ):
685	        """Build a :class:`~torch.nn.attention.flex_attention.BlockMask` from O(S) vectors.
686	
687	        Call once per forward (before the vision encoder) and reuse across all attention
688	        layers — matching mm_olmo's ``build_block_mask`` timing and avoiding a peak when
689	        ViT activations are already resident.
690	        """
691	        from torch.nn.attention.flex_attention import create_block_mask
692	
693	        helper = FlexAttentionBackend(
694	            head_dim=1, n_heads=1, n_kv_heads=1, scale=1.0, window_size=window_size
695	        )
696	        mask_mod = helper._build_mask_mod(is_image, subsegment_ids, None, example_id)
697	        return create_block_mask(mask_mod, B=B, H=None, Q_LEN=S, KV_LEN=S, device=device)
698	
699	    def forward(
700	        self,
701	        qkv: Union[torch.Tensor, Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]],
702	        cu_doc_lens: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
703	        cu_doc_lens_q: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
704	        cu_doc_lens_k: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
705	        max_doc_len: Optional[int] = None,
706	        max_doc_len_q: Optional[int] = None,
707	        max_doc_len_k: Optional[int] = None,
708	        local_k_slice: Optional[slice] = None,
709	        kv_cache_manager: Optional[KVCacheManager] = None,
710	        or_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
711	        and_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
712	        sinks: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
713	        flex_attn_is_image: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
714	        flex_attn_subsegment_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
715	        flex_attn_example_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
716	        flex_attn_block_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
717	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
718	        from torch.nn.attention.flex_attention import create_block_mask
719	
720	        del local_k_slice
721	        if sinks is not None:
722	            raise RuntimeError(f"'{self.__class__.__name__}' doesn't support attention sinks")
723	        if isinstance(qkv, torch.Tensor):
724	            raise RuntimeError(f"'{self.__class__.__name__}' doesn't support packed QKV")
725	        if kv_cache_manager is not None:
726	            raise RuntimeError(f"'{self.__class__.__name__}' doesn't support KV caching")
727	        if self.dropout_p:
728	            raise RuntimeError(f"'{self.__class__.__name__}' doesn't support attention dropout")
729	        if self.cp_enabled:
730	            raise RuntimeError(f"'{self.__class__.__name__}' doesn't support context parallelism")
731	        if any(
732	            opt is not None
733	            for opt in (
734	                cu_doc_lens,
735	                cu_doc_lens_q,
736	                cu_doc_lens_k,
737	                max_doc_len,
738	                max_doc_len_q,
739	                max_doc_len_k,
740	            )
741	        ):
742	            raise RuntimeError(
743	                f"'{self.__class__.__name__}' doesn't support intra-document masking"
744	            )
745	
746	        q, k, v = qkv
747	        # PyTorch SDPA-style GQA expansion + (B, S, H, D) -> (B, H, S, D).
748	        n_rep = self.n_heads // self.n_kv_heads
749	        k = _repeat_kv(k, n_rep)
750	        v = _repeat_kv(v, n_rep)
751	        q, k, v = q.transpose(1, 2), k.transpose(1, 2), v.transpose(1, 2)
752	
753	        B, _, S_q, _ = q.shape
754	        S_kv = k.shape[2]
755	        if flex_attn_block_mask is not None:
756	            block_mask = flex_attn_block_mask
757	        else:
758	            if (
759	                flex_attn_is_image is not None
760	                or flex_attn_subsegment_ids is not None
761	                or flex_attn_example_ids is not None
762	            ):
763	                # O(S) per-token vectors from MultimodalLM — avoids materializing (B, S, S) masks
764	                # at 16k sequence length.
765	                is_image = flex_attn_is_image
766	                subsegment_ids = flex_attn_subsegment_ids
767	                seg_code = None
768	                example_id = flex_attn_example_ids
769	            else:
770	                om = or_mask.to(device=q.device, dtype=torch.bool) if or_mask is not None else None
771	                am = (
772	                    and_mask.to(device=q.device, dtype=torch.bool) if and_mask is not None else None
773	                )
774	                is_image, seg_code, example_id = self._per_token_from_masks(om, am)
775	                subsegment_ids = None
776	            mask_mod = self._build_mask_mod(is_image, subsegment_ids, seg_code, example_id)
777	            # `B`/`H=None` so the mask may depend on the batch index (image / subsegment ids are
778	            # per-example) but broadcasts over heads. Rebuilt each step since the masks are data
779	            # dependent; block-sparsity makes this cheap.
780	            block_mask = create_block_mask(
781	                mask_mod, B=B, H=None, Q_LEN=S_q, KV_LEN=S_kv, device=q.device
782	            )
783	        flex = _get_flex_attention(q.device)
784	        att = flex(q, k, v, block_mask=block_mask, scale=self.scale)
785	
786	        # (B, H, S, D) -> (B, S, H, D)
787	        return att.transpose(1, 2).contiguous()

import logging

import torch
import torch.distributed as dist

        flash_attn_3 = None  # type: ignore

except ImportError:
    ring_flash_attn = None  # type: ignore

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def has_flash_attn_2() -> bool:
    return flash_attn_2 is not None


def has_flash_attn_3() -> bool:
    if flash_attn_3 is not None:
        if torch.cuda.is_available():
            compute_capability = torch.cuda.get_device_capability()
            is_supported = (9, 0) <= compute_capability < (10, 0)  # H100 / H800
            return is_supported
        return True
    return False


def has_flash_attn_4() -> bool:
    if flash_attn_4 is not None:
        if torch.cuda.is_available():
            compute_capability = torch.cuda.get_device_capability()
            return compute_capability >= (10, 0) and compute_capability <= (
                12,
                0,
            )  # Blackwell, Blackwell Ultra
        return True
    return False


def has_ring_flash_attn() -> bool:
    return ring_flash_attn is not None


def _flatten_batch_dim(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    B, T, *other = x.shape
    return x.view(B * T, *other)


def dispatch_flash_attn(
    q: torch.Tensor,
    k: torch.Tensor,
    v: torch.Tensor,
    *,
    cu_seqlens: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
    cu_seqlens_q: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
    cu_seqlens_k: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
    max_seqlen: Optional[int] = None,
    max_seqlen_q: Optional[int] = None,
    max_seqlen_k: Optional[int] = None,
    dropout_p: float = 0.0,
    softmax_scale: Optional[float] = None,
    causal: bool = False,
    window_size: Tuple[int, int] = (-1, -1),
) -> torch.Tensor:
    if flash_attn_2 is None:
        raise RuntimeError("flash-attn 2 is required!")

    if cu_seqlens is not None:
        cu_seqlens_q = cu_seqlens if cu_seqlens_q is None else cu_seqlens_q
        cu_seqlens_k = cu_seqlens if cu_seqlens_k is None else cu_seqlens_k
    if max_seqlen is not None:
        max_seqlen_q = max_seqlen if max_seqlen_q is None else max_seqlen_q
        max_seqlen_k = max_seqlen if max_seqlen_k is None else max_seqlen_k

    varlen = all(x is not None for x in (cu_seqlens_q, cu_seqlens_k, max_seqlen_q, max_seqlen_k))

    if varlen:
        return flash_attn_2.flash_attn_varlen_func(
            _flatten_batch_dim(q),
            _flatten_batch_dim(k),
            _flatten_batch_dim(v),
            cu_seqlens_q,
            cu_seqlens_k,
            max_seqlen_q,
            max_seqlen_k,
            dropout_p=dropout_p,
            softmax_scale=softmax_scale,
            causal=causal,
            window_size=window_size,
        )
    else:
        return flash_attn_2.flash_attn_func(
            q,
            k,
            v,
            dropout_p=dropout_p,
            softmax_scale=softmax_scale,
            causal=causal,
            window_size=window_size,
        )

    k: torch.Tensor,
    v: torch.Tensor,
    *,
    group: dist.ProcessGroup,
    strategy: RingAttentionLoadBalancerType,
    cu_seqlens: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
    cu_seqlens_q: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
    cu_seqlens_k: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,

) -> torch.Tensor:

    if strategy == RingAttentionLoadBalancerType.zig_zag:
        if any(x is not None for x in (cu_seqlens_q, cu_seqlens_k, max_seqlen_q, max_seqlen_k)):

                f"{strategy} load balancing strategy requires unified QK doc lengths"
            )

        if local_k_slice is not None:
            raise RuntimeError(f"'local_k_slice' is invalid for {strategy} load balancing strategy")

        if window_size != (-1, -1):
            # See https://github.com/zhuzilin/ring-flash-attention/issues/35
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"SWA is currently not supported for {strategy} load balancing strategy"
            )

        if cu_seqlens is not None and max_seqlen is not None:
            out = ring_flash_attn.zigzag_ring_flash_attn_varlen_func(

                softmax_scale=softmax_scale,
                causal=causal,

            _flatten_batch_dim(v),
            cu_seqlens_q,

            local_k_slice,
            dropout_p=dropout_p,

184	class _MXFP8SavedQKVHooks:
185	    def __init__(
186	        self,
187	        q: torch.Tensor,
188	        k: torch.Tensor,
189	        v: torch.Tensor,
190	        *,
191	        pack_counter: list[int],
192	    ) -> None:
193	        # Match by storage pointer, not tensor identity. The attention backend transposes (and, for
194	        # GQA, may repeat) q/k/v into new tensor objects before SDPA, and autograd saves *those*
195	        # derived tensors. View transforms such as transpose share storage with the originals, so a
196	        # storage-pointer key still recognizes them; identity matching would miss all of them and
197	        # the pack would silently no-op. (A GQA repeat that copies k/v gets fresh storage and is
198	        # not matched -- acceptable, and it never mis-packs an unrelated tensor.)
199	        self.target_names = {
200	            q.untyped_storage().data_ptr(): "attention.q",
201	            k.untyped_storage().data_ptr(): "attention.k",
202	            v.untyped_storage().data_ptr(): "attention.v",
203	        }
204	        self.pack_counter = pack_counter
205	
206	    def pack(self, t: torch.Tensor) -> Any:
207	        name = self.target_names.get(t.untyped_storage().data_ptr())
208	        if name is None:
209	            _record_saved_activation_debug(t, "attention.sdpa.saved_passthrough")
210	            return t
211	        if not _can_save_tensor_as_mxfp8(t):
212	            return t
213	
214	        self.pack_counter[0] += 1
215	        return _pack_mxfp8_saved_tensor(t, name=name)
216	
217	    def unpack(self, x: Any) -> torch.Tensor:
218	        if not isinstance(x, _MXFP8SavedTensor):
219	            return x
220	
221	        return _unpack_mxfp8_saved_tensor(x)
222

251	@dataclass
252	class SlidingWindowAttentionConfig(Config):
253	    pattern: List[int]
254	    """
255	    The pattern of window sizes to use for attention, repeated to cover all layers.
256	    A value of -1 indicates full attention. For example, a pattern of ``[4096, 4096, 4096, -1]``
257	    means that for each set of 4 layers, the first 3 will use a window size of 4096,
258	    and the last layer will use full attention.
259	    """
260	
261	    force_full_attention_on_first_layer: bool = True
262	    """
263	    If `True`, the first transformer layer will always use full attention, regardless of the pattern.
264	    """
265	
266	    force_full_attention_on_last_layer: bool = True
267	    """
268	    If `True`, the last transformer layer will always use full attention, regardless of the pattern.
269	    """
270	
271	    def _get_window_size(self, layer_idx: int, n_layers: int) -> int:
272	        """
273	        Get the window size for a given layer, returning -1 for full attention.
274	        """
275	        if self.force_full_attention_on_first_layer and layer_idx == 0:
276	            return -1
277	        if self.force_full_attention_on_last_layer and layer_idx == (n_layers - 1):
278	            return -1
279	
280	        # Adjust the layer index if the first layer is special-cased to full attention
281	        # (in which case the pattern is applied starting from the second layer)
282	        effective_layer_idx = layer_idx
283	        if self.force_full_attention_on_first_layer:
284	            effective_layer_idx -= 1
285	
286	        window_size = self.pattern[effective_layer_idx % len(self.pattern)]
287	        if window_size <= 0 and window_size != -1:
288	            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
289	                f"Sliding window size must be positive or -1 (got {window_size})"
290	            )
291	        return window_size
292	
293	    def should_use_swa(self, layer_idx: int, n_layers: int) -> bool:
294	        """
295	        Returns `True` if the given layer uses sliding window attention.
296	        """
297	        return self._get_window_size(layer_idx, n_layers) != -1
298	
299	    def get_window_size(self, layer_idx: int, n_layers: int) -> int:
300	        """
301	        Get the sliding window size for a given layer.
302	        """
303	        window_size = self._get_window_size(layer_idx, n_layers)
304	        if window_size == -1:
305	            raise ValueError(f"Layer {layer_idx} is not configured for sliding window attention.")
306	        return window_size

356	class AttentionConfig(SequenceMixerConfig["SequenceMixer"]):
357	    """
358	    A configuration class for easily building any of the different attention modules.
359	
360	    See the individual :class:`Attention` subclasses for a description of the configuration options.
361	    """
362	
363	    name: AttentionType = AttentionType.default
364	    """
365	    The name of the implementation.
366	    """
367	    n_heads: int = 16
368	    n_kv_heads: Optional[int] = None
369	    head_dim: Optional[int] = None
370	    bias: Optional[bool] = None
371	    gate: Optional[GateConfig] = None
372	    rope: Optional[RoPEConfig] = None
373	    clip_qkv: Optional[float] = None
374	    qk_norm: Optional[LayerNormConfig] = None
375	    dropout: Optional[float] = None
376	    use_flash: Optional[bool] = None
377	    """Deprecated input retained for old configs; use :data:`backend` in new configs."""
378	    backend: Optional[AttentionBackendName] = None
379	    dtype: DType = DType.float32
380	    sliding_window: Optional[SlidingWindowAttentionConfig] = None
381	    use_head_qk_norm: Optional[bool] = None
382	    scalable_softmax: bool = False
383	    """Scalable softmax; incompatible with CP, KV caching, and sliding window attention."""
384	    qk_norm_per_head_gains: Optional[bool] = None
385	    attention_sinks: bool = False
386	    """
387	    Add a per-head learnable "attention sink" logit (as in GPT-OSS). Only supported by the default
388	    attention with the torch backend.
389	    """
390	    mxfp8_projections: Optional[bool] = None
391	    """
392	    Shorthand for using :class:`MXFP8Linear` for both of :class:`FusedAttentionV2`'s packed QKV and
393	    output projections. Only supported by ``fused_v2`` attention.
394	    """
395	    mxfp8_qkv_projection: Optional[bool] = None
396	    """
397	    Use :class:`MXFP8Linear` for :class:`FusedAttentionV2`'s packed QKV projection.
398	    """
399	    mxfp8_out_projection: Optional[bool] = None
400	    """
401	    Use :class:`MXFP8Linear` for :class:`FusedAttentionV2`'s output projection.
402	    """
403	    use_recompute_qkv_prep: Optional[bool] = None
404	    """
405	    Recompute the Q/K/V preparation in the backward pass to save activation memory. Supported by the
406	    ``default`` and ``fused_v2`` attention implementations.
407	    """
408	    mxfp8_save_qkv_for_backward: Optional[bool] = None
409	    """
410	    Save Q/K/V for backward as MXFP8 to reduce the saved-activation footprint. Supported by the
411	    ``default`` and ``fused_v2`` attention implementations.
412	
413	    .. note::
414	        The flash backends save Q/K/V unmodified, so all three are packed. The ``torch`` backend
415	        transposes Q/K/V (a view -> still packed) but for GQA (``n_kv_heads < n_heads``) it also
416	        repeats K/V into fresh storage before SDPA, so only Q is packed for GQA on that backend.
417	    """
418	
419	    def num_params(self, d_model: int) -> int:
420	        """
421	        The number of params that the attention implementation will have once built.
422	
423	        :param d_model: The model dimensionality.
424	        """
425	        n_heads = self.n_heads
426	        n_kv_heads = self.n_kv_heads or n_heads
427	        head_dim = self.head_dim or d_model // n_heads
428	        bias = self.bias if self.bias is not None else self.name != AttentionType.normalized
429	
430	        params = 0
431	
432	        # Block attention Q projection.
433	        params += d_model * n_heads * head_dim
434	        if bias:
435	            params += n_heads * head_dim
436	
437	        # Block attention KV projections.
438	        params += 2 * d_model * n_kv_heads * head_dim
439	        if bias:
440	            params += 2 * n_kv_heads * head_dim
441	
442	        # Block attention QK norm.
443	        if self.qk_norm is not None:
444	            if self.use_head_qk_norm and not self.qk_norm_per_head_gains:
445	                params += 2 * self.qk_norm.num_params(head_dim)
446	            else:
447	                params += self.qk_norm.num_params(n_heads * head_dim)  # q_norm
448	                params += self.qk_norm.num_params(n_kv_heads * head_dim)  # k_norm
449	
450	        # Block attention out.
451	        params += n_heads * head_dim * d_model
452	        if bias:
453	            params += d_model
454	
455	        # Block attention gate projection.
456	        if self.gate is not None:
457	            if self.gate.granularity == GateGranularity.headwise:
458	                params += d_model * n_heads
459	                if bias:
460	                    params += n_heads
461	            elif self.gate.granularity == GateGranularity.elementwise:
462	                params += d_model * (n_heads * head_dim)
463	                if bias:
464	                    params += n_heads * head_dim
465	
466	        # Block QK scaling factors.
467	        if self.name == AttentionType.normalized:
468	            params += n_heads * head_dim
469	            params += n_kv_heads * head_dim
470	
471	        # Per-head attention-sink logits.
472	        if self.attention_sinks:
473	            params += n_heads
474	
475	        # Per-head scalable-softmax factors.
476	        if self.scalable_softmax:
477	            params += n_heads
478	
479	        return params
480	
481	    def build(
482	        self,
483	        d_model: int,
484	        *,
485	        layer_idx: int,
486	        n_layers: int,
487	        init_device: str = "cpu",
488	        cache: Optional[BufferCache] = None,
489	    ) -> "SequenceMixer":
490	        """
491	        Build the corresponding attention module.
492	
493	        :param d_model: The model dimensionality.
494	        :param init_device: The device to initialize the parameters on, e.g. "cpu", "meta".
495	        """
496	        if self.name == AttentionType.fused:
497	            warnings.warn(
498	                "The 'fused' attention implementation has been removed; using FusedAttentionV2. "
499	                "Checkpoint parameter names and shapes are preserved, but regular RoPE is "
500	                "not numerically identical to fused RoPE.",
501	                UserWarning,
502	                stacklevel=2,
503	            )
504	            rope = self.rope
505	            if rope is not None and rope.name == RoPEType.fused:
506	                rope = replace(rope, name=RoPEType.default)
507	            return replace(
508	                self,
509	                name=AttentionType.fused_v2,
510	                rope=rope,
511	                backend=self.backend or AttentionBackendName.flash_2,
512	                use_flash=None,  # The original implementation ignored this flag.
513	            ).build(
514	                d_model,
515	                layer_idx=layer_idx,
516	                n_layers=n_layers,
517	                init_device=init_device,
518	                cache=cache,
519	            )
520	
521	        kwargs = self.as_dict(exclude_none=True, recurse=False)
522	        kwargs.pop("name")
523	
524	        sliding_window_config: Optional[SlidingWindowAttentionConfig] = kwargs.pop(
525	            "sliding_window", None
526	        )
527	        if sliding_window_config is not None and sliding_window_config.should_use_swa(
528	            layer_idx, n_layers
529	        ):
530	            if self.scalable_softmax:
531	                raise OLMoConfigurationError(
532	                    "'scalable_softmax' is not supported with sliding window attention"
533	                )
534	            kwargs["window_size"] = sliding_window_config.get_window_size(layer_idx, n_layers)
535	        else:  # global (non-SWA) layer
536	            rope_config: Optional[RoPEConfig] = kwargs.get("rope")
537	            if rope_config is not None and rope_config.no_global_rope:
538	                kwargs["rope"] = None
539	
540	        kwargs.update(
541	            dtype=kwargs.pop("dtype").as_pt(),
542	            d_model=d_model,
543	            init_device=init_device,
544	            cache=cache,
545	        )
546	
547	        # Attention sinks are only wired up for the default attention; drop the flag otherwise so
548	        # the other implementations don't see an unexpected keyword argument.
549	        if not kwargs.get("attention_sinks", False):
550	            kwargs.pop("attention_sinks", None)
551	        elif self.name != AttentionType.default:
552	            raise OLMoConfigurationError("attention_sinks are only supported by default attention")
553	
554	        # The MXFP8 packed-projection options are only wired up for fused_v2 attention; route them
555	        # there and reject them for any other implementation. A disabled (falsy) flag is a no-op, so
556	        # only reject when one is actually enabled.
557	        fused_v2_kwargs = {
558	            key: kwargs.pop(key)
559	            for key in ("mxfp8_projections", "mxfp8_qkv_projection", "mxfp8_out_projection")
560	            if key in kwargs
561	        }
562	        if any(fused_v2_kwargs.values()) and self.name != AttentionType.fused_v2:
563	            enabled = sorted(key for key, value in fused_v2_kwargs.items() if value)
564	            raise OLMoConfigurationError(f"{enabled} are only supported by fused_v2 attention")
565	
566	        # QKV recompute / MXFP8-save are honored by the shared Attention.forward, so they apply to
567	        # the default and fused_v2 implementations (normalized overrides forward). As above,
568	        # only reject an enabled flag.
569	        shared_forward_kwargs = {
570	            key: kwargs.pop(key)
571	            for key in ("use_recompute_qkv_prep", "mxfp8_save_qkv_for_backward")
572	            if key in kwargs
573	        }
574	        if any(shared_forward_kwargs.values()) and self.name not in (
575	            AttentionType.default,
576	            AttentionType.fused_v2,
577	        ):
578	            enabled = sorted(key for key, value in shared_forward_kwargs.items() if value)
579	            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
580	                f"{enabled} are only supported by default and fused_v2 attention"
581	            )
582	
583	        if self.name != AttentionType.default:
584	            for key in ("scalable_softmax", "qk_norm_per_head_gains"):
585	                if kwargs.pop(key, False):
586	                    raise OLMoConfigurationError(
587	                        f"'{key}' is not supported with {self.name} attention"
588	                    )
589	
590	        try:
591	            if self.name == "default":
592	                return Attention(**kwargs, **shared_forward_kwargs)
593	            elif self.name == "fused_v2":
594	                return FusedAttentionV2(**kwargs, **fused_v2_kwargs, **shared_forward_kwargs)
595	            elif self.name == "normalized":
596	                if "window_size" in kwargs:
597	                    raise OLMoConfigurationError(
598	                        "'window_size' is not supported with normalized attention"
599	                    )
600	                return NormalizedAttention(**kwargs)
601	            else:
602	                raise NotImplementedError(self.name)
603	        except TypeError as e:
604	            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
605	                f"invalid options for '{self.name}' {self.__class__.__name__}, {e}"
606	            ) from e

609	def _causal_attention_positions(seq_len: int, window_size: Optional[int] = None) -> int:
610	    """
611	    The number of attended ``(query, key)`` pairs across a sequence under causal masking, optionally
612	    capped by a sliding window.
613	
614	    For full causal attention this is the triangle ``seq_len * (seq_len + 1) // 2`` (each query
615	    attends to itself and all earlier tokens). With a sliding ``window_size`` each query attends to
616	    at most ``window_size`` positions, so the early queries still form a triangle while the rest
617	    contribute a flat ``window_size`` each.
618	
619	    :param seq_len: The sequence length.
620	    :param window_size: The sliding-window size, or ``None`` for full causal attention.
621	    """
622	    if window_size is None or window_size >= seq_len:
623	        return seq_len * (seq_len + 1) // 2
624	    return window_size * (window_size + 1) // 2 + (seq_len - window_size) * window_size
625

627	class Attention(SequenceMixer):
628	    """
629	    An implementation of multi-head self-attention with support for multi-query (MQA)
630	    and grouped-query (GQA) attention.
631	
632	    Intra-document masking is also supported by passing in the
633	    ``max_doc_len`` and ``cu_doc_lens`` parameters to :meth:`forward()`. This requires
634	    a backend that supports it, like the flash backend.
635	
636	    .. seealso::
637	        :class:`FusedAttentionV2` for a packed QKV projection.
638	
639	    :param d_model: The model hidden size.
640	    :param n_heads: The number of attention heads.
641	    :param n_kv_heads: The number of key and value heads, if different.
642	    :param bias: Include biases with linear layers.
643	    :param gate: Configuration for attention gating. If None, no gating is applied.
644	    :param rope: The config for RoPE, if RoPE should be used.
645	    :param clip_qkv: Clip QKV to this value, if set.
646	    :param qk_norm: Configuration a layer norm for queries and keys.
647	    :param use_head_qk_norm: Apply the QK norm head-wise, i.e. to each head separately with
648	        normalization statistics computed over ``head_dim`` instead of the full hidden dimension.
649	    :param qk_norm_per_head_gains: Give each head its own norm gain (and bias) parameters instead
650	        of sharing them across heads. Requires ``use_head_qk_norm=True``.
651	    :param dropout: Dropout probability.
652	    :param use_flash: Deprecated, use ``backend="flash_2"`` instead.
653	    :param backend: The attention backend to use. If not set, it will be chosen automatically.
654	    :param scalable_softmax: Use Scalable-Softmax with a learned scale for each query head.
655	        Context parallelism, KV caching, and sliding window attention are unsupported.
656	    :param dtype: The default data type to use for parameters.
657	    :param init_device: The device to initialize weights on.
658	    """
659	
660	    def __init__(
661	        self,
662	        *,
663	        d_model: int,

895	    def _apply_scalable_softmax(
896	        self,
897	        q: torch.Tensor,
898	        cu_doc_lens: Optional[torch.Tensor],
899	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
900	        if not self.scalable_softmax:
901	            return q
902	        if self.cp_enabled:
903	            raise NotImplementedError("Scalable-Softmax is not supported with context parallelism")
904	        if self.kv_cache_manager is not None:
905	            raise NotImplementedError("Scalable-Softmax is not supported with KV caching")
906	
907	        if cu_doc_lens is None:
908	            visible_lengths = torch.arange(1, q.shape[1] + 1, device=q.device)
909	            visible_lengths = visible_lengths.unsqueeze(0).expand(q.shape[0], -1)
910	        else:
911	            boundaries = cu_doc_lens.to(device=q.device)
912	            token_indices = torch.arange(
913	                q.shape[0] * q.shape[1], device=q.device, dtype=boundaries.dtype
914	            )
915	            document_indices = torch.searchsorted(boundaries[1:], token_indices, right=True)
916	            document_starts = boundaries[document_indices]
917	            visible_lengths = (token_indices - document_starts + 1).view(q.shape[0], q.shape[1])
918	
919	        assert self.ssmax_scale is not None
920	        ssmax_scale = self.ssmax_scale
921	        if isinstance(ssmax_scale, DTensor):
922	            ssmax_scale = ssmax_scale.to_local()
923	        scale = visible_lengths.log().to(q.dtype).unsqueeze(-1)
924	        scale = scale * ssmax_scale.to(q.dtype).view(1, 1, -1)
925	        return q * scale.unsqueeze(-1)

965	    def _prepare_qkv(
966	        self,
967	        x: torch.Tensor,
968	        *,
969	        pos_sin: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
970	        pos_cos: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
971	        freqs_cis: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
972	        start_pos: Optional[int] = None,
973	        cu_doc_lens: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
974	        position_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
975	    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
976	        """
977	        Project the input into per-head Q/K/V (with clip, QK norm, and RoPE applied), returning
978	        tensors shaped ``(batch_size, seq_len, n_heads (local), head_dim)``. Subclasses can override
979	        this to change the projection layout (e.g. a packed QKV projection) while reusing
980	        :meth:`forward`.
981	        """
982	        B, T, _ = x.shape
983	
984	        # shape: (batch_size, seq_len, n_heads * head_dim),
985	        #        (batch_size, seq_len, n_kv_heads * head_dim),
986	        #        (batch_size, seq_len, n_kv_heads * head_dim)
987	        q, k, v = self.w_q(x), self.w_k(x), self.w_v(x)
988	
989	        if self.clip_qkv is not None:
990	            q.clamp_(min=-self.clip_qkv, max=self.clip_qkv)
991	            k.clamp_(min=-self.clip_qkv, max=self.clip_qkv)
992	            v.clamp_(min=-self.clip_qkv, max=self.clip_qkv)
993	
994	        if not self.use_head_qk_norm:
995	            if self.q_norm is not None:
996	                q = self.q_norm(q)
997	            if self.k_norm is not None:
998	                k = self.k_norm(k)
999	
1000	        # NOTE: use -1 instead of `n_heads` / `n_kv_heads` to infer actual local size when
1001	        # using tensor parallelism.
1002	        # shape: (batch_size, seq_len, n_heads (local), head_dim)
1003	        q = q.view(B, T, -1, self.head_dim)
1004	        # shape: (batch_size, seq_len, n_kv_heads (local), head_dim)
1005	        k = k.view(B, T, -1, self.head_dim)
1006	        # shape: (batch_size, seq_len, n_kv_heads (local), head_dim)
1007	        v = v.view(B, T, -1, self.head_dim)
1008	
1009	        if self.use_head_qk_norm:
1010	            # NOTE: with per-head gains ('qk_norm_per_head_gains=True') the norm weight has shape
1011	            # (n_heads, head_dim), and correctness relies on applying the norm *after* the
1012	            # head-wise view above so that head 'h' broadcasts against gain row 'h'. Under tensor
1013	            # parallelism this still holds: the norm runs in the sequence-sharded region where all
1014	            # heads are present locally and the weight is replicated.
1015	            if self.q_norm is not None:
1016	                q = self.q_norm(q)
1017	            if self.k_norm is not None:
1018	                k = self.k_norm(k)
1019	
1020	        if self.rope is not None:
1021	            # In context-parallel mode we must be given pre-sharded buffers
1022	            if self.cp_enabled and pos_sin is None and pos_cos is None and freqs_cis is None:
1023	                raise RuntimeError(
1024	                    "RoPE buffers must be passed through to attention after being properly "
1025	                    "sharded by the context parallel load balancer"
1026	                )
1027	
1028	            q, k = self._apply_rope(
1029	                q, k, start_pos, pos_sin, pos_cos, freqs_cis, cu_doc_lens, position_ids
1030	            )
1031	
1032	        q = self._apply_scalable_softmax(q, cu_doc_lens)
1033	        return q, k, v

1100	                position_ids=position_ids,
1101	            )
1102

1129	                or_mask=or_mask,

1133	                flex_attn_example_ids=flex_attn_example_ids,

1248	        num_blocks: int,
1249	        std: float = 0.02,
1250	        generator: Optional[torch.Generator] = None,
1251	    ) -> None:
1252	        from olmo_core.nn.transformer.init import (
1253	            InitMethod,
1254	            init_linear,
1255	            init_linear_nanochat,
1256	            nanochat_std,
1257	        )
1258	
1259	        if self.ssmax_scale is not None:

1263	            for w in (self.w_q, self.w_k, self.w_v, self.w_g, self.w_out):

1268	                    self.sinks,

1275	        # Compute std for Q/K/V initialization
1276	        if init_method == InitMethod.fan_in:
1277	            # For fan_in, use 1/√d_in based on actual weight shape (ignores base std parameter)
1278	            # Each projection may have different output dims (n_heads * head_dim vs n_kv_heads * head_dim)

1280	            for w in (self.w_q, self.w_k, self.w_v):

1286	            for w in (self.w_q, self.w_k, self.w_v):

1293	            else:
1294	                g_std = std
1295	            init_linear(self.w_g, std=g_std, generator=generator)

1297	        # Compute std for w_out initialization
1298	        if init_method == InitMethod.fan_in:
1299	            std = self.w_out.in_features**-0.5
1300	        elif init_method == InitMethod.llama:
1301	            std = std / (2 * num_blocks) ** 0.5
1302	        elif init_method == InitMethod.llama_depth:
1303	            std = std / (2 * (block_idx + 1)) ** 0.5
1304	        elif init_method == InitMethod.normalized:
1305	            std = std / (2 * num_blocks) ** 0.5
1306	
1307	        init_linear(self.w_out, std=std, generator=generator)

1312	    def init_kv_cache_manager(self, batch_size: int, max_seq_len: int):
1313	        """
1314	        Initialize the kv cache manager for attention. When the kv cache manager exists,
1315	        kv caching will be used during the forward pass. This should only be called during inference.
1316	
1317	        :param batch_size: The batch size for the cache.
1318	        :param max_seq_len: The maximum sequence length for the cache.
1319	        """
1320	        if self.scalable_softmax:
1321	            raise OLMoConfigurationError("Scalable-Softmax is not supported with KV caching")
1322	        self.backend.assert_supports_kv_cache()

1332	    def num_flops_per_token(self, seq_len: int) -> int:
1333	        """
1334	        This accounts for:
1335	        - Linear projections (Q, K, V, output, and gating if enabled)
1336	        - Attention computation (QK^T and softmax(QK^T) @ V)
1337	        - Sliding window attention (reduced effective sequence length)
1338	        """
1339	        # 6 FLOPs per parameter (2 ops * 3 for forward+backward)
1340	        param_flops = 6 * sum(p.numel() for p in self.parameters())
1341	
1342	        # Attention computation (QK^T and Attn*V).
1343	        # 12x multiplier: 2 matmuls * 2 ops each * 3 for forward+backward.
1344	        # Note that flash attention technically uses more flops (14x multiplier) due to recomputation,
1345	        # however, we just compute the idealized flops for SDPA.
1346	        #
1347	        # Historical note: this previously counted ``12 * n_heads * head_dim * effective_seq_len``
1348	        # with ``effective_seq_len = min(window_size, seq_len)``, which ignored causal masking and
1349	        # used a flat sliding-window cap. That overcounted full-attention layers by ~2x (no causal
1350	        # /2) and only roughly approximated sliding-window layers. We now count the exact causal /
1351	        # sliding-window ``(query, key)`` pairs, so reported model TFLOPs / MFU for full-attention
1352	        # runs drop on the attention-compute term relative to logs produced before this change.
1353	        attention_positions = _causal_attention_positions(seq_len, self.window_size or None)
1354	        attn_flops = 12 * self.n_heads * self.head_dim * attention_positions // seq_len
1355	
1356	        return param_flops + attn_flops

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _MXFP8SavedTensor:
    qdata: torch.Tensor
    scales: torch.Tensor
    shape: torch.Size
    dtype: torch.dtype
    name: str


def _can_save_tensor_as_mxfp8(t: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
    return (
        t.is_cuda
        and t.dtype == torch.bfloat16
        and t.ndim >= 2
        and t.shape[-1] % 32 == 0
        and t.requires_grad
    )


def _set_saved_activation_name(t: torch.Tensor, name: str) -> torch.Tensor:
    t._olmo_saved_activation_name = name  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    if os.getenv("OLMO_EP_NO_SYNC_SAVED_ACTIVATIONS_DEBUG"):
        try:
            from olmo_core.nn.moe.v2.activation_debug import (
                record_named_saved_activation,
            )

            record_named_saved_activation(t, name)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return t


def _record_saved_activation_debug(t: torch.Tensor, name: str) -> None:
    if not os.getenv("OLMO_EP_NO_SYNC_SAVED_ACTIVATIONS_DEBUG"):
        return

    try:
        from olmo_core.nn.moe.v2.activation_debug import record_named_saved_activation

        record_named_saved_activation(t, name)
    except Exception:
        pass


def _pack_mxfp8_saved_tensor(t: torch.Tensor, *, name: str) -> _MXFP8SavedTensor:
    from olmo_core.kernels.mxfp8_utils import quantize_rows_to_mxfp8

    t_2d = t.reshape(-1, t.shape[-1])
    qdata, scales = quantize_rows_to_mxfp8(t_2d, block_size=32)
    _set_saved_activation_name(qdata, f"{name}.mxfp8_qdata")
    _set_saved_activation_name(scales, f"{name}.mxfp8_scales")
    return _MXFP8SavedTensor(
        qdata=qdata,
        scales=scales,
        shape=t.shape,
        dtype=t.dtype,
        name=name,
    )


def _unpack_mxfp8_saved_tensor(x: _MXFP8SavedTensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    from olmo_core.kernels.mxfp8_utils import dequantize_rows_from_mxfp8

    t_2d = dequantize_rows_from_mxfp8(
        x.qdata,
        x.scales,
        block_size=32,
        out_dtype=x.dtype,
    )
    return t_2d.view(x.shape)


class _MXFP8SavedQKVHooks:
    def __init__(
        self,
        q: torch.Tensor,
        k: torch.Tensor,
        v: torch.Tensor,
        *,
        pack_counter: list[int],
    ) -> None:
        # Match by storage pointer, not tensor identity. The attention backend transposes (and, for
        # GQA, may repeat) q/k/v into new tensor objects before SDPA, and autograd saves *those*
        # derived tensors. View transforms such as transpose share storage with the originals, so a
        # storage-pointer key still recognizes them; identity matching would miss all of them and
        # the pack would silently no-op. (A GQA repeat that copies k/v gets fresh storage and is
        # not matched -- acceptable, and it never mis-packs an unrelated tensor.)
        self.target_names = {
            q.untyped_storage().data_ptr(): "attention.q",
            k.untyped_storage().data_ptr(): "attention.k",
            v.untyped_storage().data_ptr(): "attention.v",
        }
        self.pack_counter = pack_counter

    def pack(self, t: torch.Tensor) -> Any:
        name = self.target_names.get(t.untyped_storage().data_ptr())
        if name is None:
            _record_saved_activation_debug(t, "attention.sdpa.saved_passthrough")
            return t
        if not _can_save_tensor_as_mxfp8(t):
            return t

        self.pack_counter[0] += 1
        return _pack_mxfp8_saved_tensor(t, name=name)

    def unpack(self, x: Any) -> torch.Tensor:
        if not isinstance(x, _MXFP8SavedTensor):
            return x

        return _unpack_mxfp8_saved_tensor(x)


@torch.compiler.disable(reason="MXFP8 saved-QKV hooks close over per-forward tensors")
def _mxfp8_saved_qkv_hooks(
    q: torch.Tensor,
    k: torch.Tensor,
    v: torch.Tensor,
    *,
    pack_counter: list[int],
):
    hooks = _MXFP8SavedQKVHooks(q, k, v, pack_counter=pack_counter)
    return saved_tensors_hooks(hooks.pack, hooks.unpack)

@dataclass
class SlidingWindowAttentionConfig(Config):
    pattern: List[int]
    """
    The pattern of window sizes to use for attention, repeated to cover all layers.
    A value of -1 indicates full attention. For example, a pattern of ``[4096, 4096, 4096, -1]``
    means that for each set of 4 layers, the first 3 will use a window size of 4096,
    and the last layer will use full attention.
    """

    force_full_attention_on_first_layer: bool = True
    """
    If `True`, the first transformer layer will always use full attention, regardless of the pattern.
    """

    force_full_attention_on_last_layer: bool = True
    """
    If `True`, the last transformer layer will always use full attention, regardless of the pattern.
    """

    def _get_window_size(self, layer_idx: int, n_layers: int) -> int:
        """
        Get the window size for a given layer, returning -1 for full attention.
        """
        if self.force_full_attention_on_first_layer and layer_idx == 0:
            return -1
        if self.force_full_attention_on_last_layer and layer_idx == (n_layers - 1):
            return -1

        # Adjust the layer index if the first layer is special-cased to full attention
        # (in which case the pattern is applied starting from the second layer)
        effective_layer_idx = layer_idx
        if self.force_full_attention_on_first_layer:
            effective_layer_idx -= 1

        window_size = self.pattern[effective_layer_idx % len(self.pattern)]
        if window_size <= 0 and window_size != -1:
            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
                f"Sliding window size must be positive or -1 (got {window_size})"
            )
        return window_size

    def should_use_swa(self, layer_idx: int, n_layers: int) -> bool:
        """
        Returns `True` if the given layer uses sliding window attention.
        """
        return self._get_window_size(layer_idx, n_layers) != -1

    def get_window_size(self, layer_idx: int, n_layers: int) -> int:
        """
        Get the sliding window size for a given layer.
        """
        window_size = self._get_window_size(layer_idx, n_layers)
        if window_size == -1:
            raise ValueError(f"Layer {layer_idx} is not configured for sliding window attention.")
        return window_size


def _resolve_attention_backend(
    backend: Optional[AttentionBackendName], use_flash: Optional[bool] = None
) -> Optional[AttentionBackendName]:
    """Resolve the deprecated flag without overriding an explicit backend or SWA auto-selection."""
    if backend is not None:
        backend = AttentionBackendName(backend)
    if use_flash:
        if backend is not None and backend != AttentionBackendName.flash_2:
            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
                f"'use_flash' is only compatible with 'flash_2' backend (got '{backend}')"
            )
        elif backend is None:
            warnings.warn(
                "'use_flash' is deprecated, use 'backend=flash_2' instead",
                DeprecationWarning,
                stacklevel=3,
            )
            backend = AttentionBackendName.flash_2
    return backend
